title: Assessment of Safety Risks of Defects Found on 26 MRT Trains
what_it_is: Assessment of Safety Risks of Defects Found on 26 MRT Trains

sections.label: Hairline cracks and commuter safety
sections.summary: The hairline cracks do not compromise commuter safety, as trains are designed with a large safety margin of three.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The hairline cracks do not compromise the safety of commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The trains are designed with a large safety margin of three.

sections.label: Crack cause, assessment and repair
sections.summary: Cracks did not reduce the safety margin; an independent assessor confirmed the trains safe, and Kawasaki-Sifang will replace car-bodies, traced to a batch of aluminium.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The cracks have not reduced the safety margin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: But to be absolutely sure, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) had appointed an independent assessor, TUV Rheinland and the assessors confirmed that the trains are entirely safe to operate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Page: 24 Kawasaki-Sifang decided that the most effective repair method was to replace the entire car-body.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: This is because the bolster, where the hairline cracks are found, is welded to the car-body.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: As Kawasaki-Sifang does not have the necessary facilities in Singapore to refit the trains with new car-bodies, the trains have to be shipped back to Kawasaki-Sifang's manufacturing base in China.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The cause of the cracks was traced to a specific batch of aluminium material used for the manufacturing of the train bolsters only.

sections.label: Bolster origin and manufacturer decision
sections.summary: One bolster is made in Japan and one in China, but the manufacturers themselves decided to use new bolsters from Japan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: One is made in Japan and one is made in China.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But the decision − using new bolsters from Japan − is made by the manufacturers themselves.
